description: 'Harbor Mechanical' on Summit; PM notes Harbor is contesting; condensate damage

email.subject: Summit - BC-5010 Harbor Mechanical
email.body:
Hi,

Back-charge for Harbor Mechanical on Summit. A condensate line came apart above L4 and soaked the ceiling and two walls in the staff lounge.

BC-5010: condensate damage repair, L4 staff lounge, $4,400.00.

Harbor is contesting this one.

Dana Ortiz
Project Manager, Apex Builders
